001数论未见公开 Lean 代码

Milne 的有理性猜想

证明了具有良约化的 Q‾\overline{\mathbb Q}Q​ 上阿贝尔簇的 Milne 有理性猜想：特化后的 Hodge 类与互补维数的除子乘积配对所得为有理数，且与所选的上同调理论无关。结合第 032 组的结果，对每个剩余特征 ppp，每个特化后的 Hodge 类都可由同一个有理系数代数闭链同时在所有素于 ppp 的实现及晶体实现中表示。

英文原文

Proves Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties over Q‾\overline{\mathbb Q}Q​ with good reduction: specialized Hodge classes pair rationally with complementary divisor products, independently of cohomology theory. Together with result 032, every specialized Hodge class is represented by a single rational algebraic cycle simultaneously in all prime-to-ppp and crystalline realizations, for every residue characteristic ppp.

002数论未见公开 Lean 代码

Selmer 余秩为零或一时的完整 BSD 公式

对于 Q\mathbb QQ 上的任意椭圆曲线，若存在素数 qqq，使其完整的 qqq 幂 Selmer 群的余秩为零或一，则证明完整的 Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer 首项公式成立，其中包括 Tate–Shafarevich 群的有限性。结合第 006 组的结果，可得 Q\mathbb QQ 上每条椭圆曲线都有密度为一的二次扭曲满足完整的 BSD 公式。

英文原文

Proves the full Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for every elliptic curve over Q\mathbb QQ whose full qqq-power Selmer group has corank zero or one for some prime qqq, including finiteness of the Tate–Shafarevich group. With result 006, this gives full BSD for a density-one set of quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over Q\mathbb QQ.

Goldfeld 猜想

英文原文

Proves Goldfeld's conjecture for quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over Q\mathbb QQ: analytic ranks zero and one each have density 1/21/21/2, and the mean analytic rank tends to 1/21/21/2. Both statements order signed squarefree twist parameters by absolute value.

受限几何 Langlands、Ramanujan 与 Arthur 参数

在所列的四个 Lie 理论特征假设下，证明了 F‾q\overline{\mathbb F}_qFq​ 上光滑射影连通曲线的连通约化群所对应的受限几何 Langlands 等价。在任意特征为 p>0p>0p>0 的代数闭域上，若另假设 ppp 对该群是非常好的素数且 p∤∣WG∣p\nmid |W_G|p∤∣WG​∣，则同样的结论成立。在整体函数域上，对于分裂、伴随型、绝对单的例外群的整体 generic 尖点表示，证明其在每个地方都满足 Ramanujan 猜想，不限制特征或分歧深度；对于具有 generic 非分歧分量的分裂、伴随型、绝对单群的尖点表示，则证明其在每个非分歧地方都满足该猜想。假设有限水平的 Ramanujan–Arthur 分解成立，则对分裂连通半单群，在有限全水平下构造实际出现的尖点 excursion 参数的整体 Arthur 增强；在整个 Weil 群（包括惯性群）上作对角特化，即恢复给定参数。

英文原文

Proves the restricted geometric Langlands equivalence for connected reductive groups on smooth projective connected curves over F‾q\overline{\mathbb F}_qFq​ under the four stated Lie-theoretic characteristic hypotheses. Over arbitrary algebraically closed fields of characteristic p>0p>0p>0, the same conclusion holds assuming additionally that ppp is very good for the group and p∤∣WG∣p\nmid |W_G|p∤∣WG​∣. Over global function fields, proves Ramanujan at every place for globally generic cuspidal representations of split adjoint absolutely simple exceptional groups, without characteristic or ramification-depth restrictions, and at every unramified place for cuspidal representations of split adjoint absolutely simple groups with a generic unramified component. Assuming the finite-level Ramanujan–Arthur decomposition, constructs global Arthur enhancements of occurring cuspidal excursion parameters for split connected semisimple groups at full finite level, recovering the given parameters by diagonal specialization on the entire Weil group, including inertia.

素数次、四次及六次的环面包等分布

证明了来自全实数域、按体积加权的完整环面包按 Haar 测度等分布，且不发生质量逃逸：范围包括固定为至少五的素数次数时的任意格及指定局部类型，本原四次数域中任意整序的 Picard 包，以及本原六次数域中极大整序的理想类包。这里“本原”指不存在真中间域；相关整序或数域的判别式趋于无穷。

英文原文

Proves Haar equidistribution without escape of mass for complete volume-weighted torus packets from totally real fields: arbitrary lattices and prescribed local types in fixed prime degree at least five, arbitrary-order Picard packets in primitive quartic fields, and maximal-order ideal-class packets in primitive sextic fields. Here primitive means having no proper intermediate field; the relevant order or field discriminant tends to infinity.
